limits: This is historical combined-formatter verification at the named source/package identities, with a separate five-RED prerequisite audit; no broad new law/model/grammar review is claimed.

The complete primary file passed 238 registrations with the original 100-run properties, fixed seed 20261118 and random campaigns; the four selected mixed histories do not establish the complete mixed corpus or arbitrary action histories.

Eleven does-not-apply authored definitions and one missing-break-return survivor remain open in this historical complete-primary report. Sample 1 is partial; no full mutation, final-tree or bug-class closure follows.

The primary property calls breakEdit in a browser. The four mixed histories use the full React editor Shift+Enter path, but no separately retained trusted Shift+Enter event receipt equivalent to the Tab receipt is established.

Small viewports do not establish physical-mobile behavior. Browser acquisition/version receipts do not identify actual browser PIDs/executables or prove individual-browser cleanup; exact enclosing recorded-container cleanup is bound.

Reach values combine retained baseline and mutation captures. They are maximum retained counts for 44 + 13 + 2 state keys across 150 campaign-unit labels, not per-baseline counts or a distinct-history total.

The initial denied Docker attempt remains setup failure with no CID or oracle result. Later exact-name/job-label absence observations and cache reset precede the successful retry; they do not retroactively turn the initial attempt into RED, GREEN or a kill.
This does not establish all sixteen oracle files, complete baselines for every area, cross-browser behavior, a complete cold CI run, acceptance of the old-test retirement or PR readiness.

checklistScope.ORC-010: Six normal current wrapper exits, exact recorded-CID cleanup and clear terminal cut are independently audited. Initial denied setup, failed original RED orchestration and later recovery remain separate.
checklistScope.ORC-012: This versioned record supplements the exact-source independent 153-condition execution audit and five-prior-RED 40-condition audit. It is not a comprehensive new oracle conformance review.
checklistScope.ORC-015: Retained reach output covers all 150 fixed/random campaign-unit labels and positive counts for 44 + 13 + 2 declared-state keys; no per-baseline reach count is inferred.
checklistScope.otherRequirements: No oracle, law, model, grammar, driver or check is introduced or changed by this evidence record. Their prior reviews and adopted authority remain separate.

portability: This compact versioned record retains verdicts, exact commands, scopes, identities, original RED summaries and historical outcomes. Raw reports/logs, independent audit and the 290-file successful, 16-file denied-attempt and 6-file recovery archives remain task-local. Hashes do not make unavailable artifacts portable. This record is historical fence verification, not final refreshed-mutant or PR-readiness evidence.
